text:
deploy-bot: [deploybot] Canary report: embeddings-service v4.5.7 increased 5xx in us-central1 at 12% traffic. Error 3.9% baseline 0.05. Suggested hotfix image: gcr.io/infra/embeddings:v4.5.7-hotfix. Request expedited pin.
Carmen: seen it on the cost dashboard, customer-facing errors. Root cause looks like race in cache refresh after config hot-reload. I have a patch.
Jared: patch LGTM; small mutex and guard. Unit + quick perf locally.
Oncall-SRE: can we rollback to v4.5.6? That restores stability but drops a perf improvement we shipped.
Carmen: rollback makes some latency regressions for bulk batch jobs; prefer hotfix if we can fast-verify.
Oncall-SRE: Fastpath skip-canary checklist: two eng approvers, staging smoke ok, e2e sanity, rollback cmd posted, pager on-call aware.
Jared: I can approve and run staging smoke.
Infra-Lee: I'll open the release window and stand by for routing changes.
release-bot: [release-bot] Staging smoke: 8/8 OK. E2E sanity queued (ETA 4m).
Jared: e2e passed. Posting commands now.
Jared: Deploy command:
```
kubectl set image deploy/embeddings embeddings=gcr.io/infra/embeddings:v4.5.7-hotfix && deployctl rollout --stages=5,40,100 --interval=600 --pin
```
Jared: Rollback command:
```
deployctl rollback --svc=embeddings --to-image=gcr.io/infra/embeddings:v4.5.6 --force
```
Carmen: Release blurb: "Fix cache refresh race causing intermittent 5xx on embeddings; preserves bulk throughput."
Oncall-SRE: two approvers present (Jared, Carmen). Pager on-call is assigned and watching. Auto-rollback set: error >1% sustained for 2m or p95 >800ms.
Infra-Lee: kicking off deploy.
deploy-bot: [deploybot] Rollout started by Infra-Lee. Stage1 5%. Link: https://ci/reports/3019876543
Jared: quick smoke OK.
Oncall-SRE: metrics stable at 0.07% errors, p95 240ms. Moving to 40% in 5m.
deploy-bot: Stage2 started: 40%.
Carmen: logs look clean. No cache lock errors.
Infra-Lee: scheduling final 100% after 10m quiet.
deploy-bot: Stage3 started: 100%. Rollout complete. No autos.
Oncall-SRE: monitoring 30m post-deploy. Close fastpath window in 45m.
Carmen: I'll add approvals and commands to the release ticket and attach smoke logs. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
